verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a dedicated interactive API reference with runnable examples for SolidJS; the only related mentions are of a landing-page playground widget, which is not the same as an API reference, and community reports note that this widget and its examples frequently failed to load or display correctly (solid-comm-6, solid-comm-7). There's no first-party (github) claim of an API reference feature to even establish the axis as delivered.
